5.0.SP2.description: Point on benchmark curve. Free form values: e.g. "1Y", "7Y", "INTERPOLATED". Sample values: 1M = combination of a number between 1-12 and a "M" for month 1Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon See Fixed Income-specific documentation at www.fixtrading.org for additional values. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)
